text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More than 12 million voters expected to take part in elections for local councils on June 13.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali meets Guinea Bissau's envoy over ways to strengthen cooperation.
- King Hassan meets French Equipment, Housing, Transport and Tourism Minister Bernard Pons who hands him message from President Jacques Chirac.
- France looking at ways to help Moroccan jobless expatriates who want to return home.
- Casablanca concession contract granting management of its water and electricity distribution to French firm Lyonnaise des Eaux paves the way for other cities.
- Police discover 264 kg (580 pounds) of cannabis hidden in a cave in a cliff near the northern city of Al Hoceima.
- Draft budget gives priority to financial balance at the expense of social and economic stability.
- U.N. Secretary-General Kofi Annan to issue report on the Western Sahara on May 9, following tour of the region by his special envoy James Baker.
